dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire The real magic is when you choose each other and don't think you deserve one another. I'm about to be 40, my wife 42. After 11 years of marriage, we feel like we're on our honeymoon. Things are......going well....really really well.

@dogecoin_empire I married a woman with very little material needs. She barely asks me for anything. As I have become more financially successful, I have found it very enjoyable to spoil the absolute shit out of her. She deserves it so much.
